title: Concept Drift from a Causal Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2609.25340v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concept drift is a common phenomenon in real-world data streams, in which changes in the data-generating distribution can degrade predictive model performance. Most existing definitions characterize drift as changes in the joint distribution $P(\mathbf{x}, y)$, without distinguishing which component of the data-generating process has changed. In this work, we introduce a causal perspective on concept drift based on Structural Causal Models (SCMs). We propose a taxonomy that categorizes drift events by their causal origin, including changes in exogenous variables, endogenous mechanisms, confounders, and target-generating processes. Building on this framework, we develop an SCM-based data stream generator that simulates controlled mechanism-level drift events. Our experiments empirically characterize the distributional effects of each drift type and show that drifts with different causal origins induce distinct patterns of distribution shi

translated_title: 从因果视角看概念漂移
translated_abstract: 概念漂移是现实世界数据流中的常见现象，数据生成分布的变化会导致预测模型性能下降。现有的大多数定义将漂移刻画为联合分布 $P(\mathbf{x}, y)$ 的变化，而未区分数据生成过程中究竟是哪个组成部分发生了改变。在本工作中，我们基于结构因果模型（SCM）提出了概念漂移的因果视角。我们提出了一种分类体系，根据漂移事件的因果来源对其进行分类，包括外生变量的变化、内生机制的变化、混淆变量的变化以及目标生成过程的变化。在该框架的基础上，我们开发了一个基于SCM的数据流生成器，能够模拟可控的机制级漂移事件。我们的实验从实证角度刻画了每种漂移类型所引起的分布效应，并表明具有不同因果来源的漂移会诱发不同的分布变化模式。
tldr: 该论文基于结构因果模型（SCM）提出概念漂移的因果分类体系，按因果来源将漂移事件分为外生变量、内生机制、混淆变量和目标生成过程的变化，并开发了可模拟受控机制级漂移的SCM数据流生成器，实验证明不同因果来源的漂移引发不同的分布变化模式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a causal perspective on concept drift via Structural Causal Models, proposing a taxonomy that categorizes drift events by their causal origin (exogenous variables, endogenous mechanisms, confounders, and target-generating processes), and develops an SCM-based data stream generator showing that drifts with different causal origins induce distinct distributional shift patterns.
